searchText: Which value is currently sent as `safeBlockHash` in `fcU` by different CL clients? Asking this because I can't find any recommendations other than the one we have in the Kintsugi spec: > Thus, CL client software MUST use headBlockHash value as a stub for the safeBlockHash parameter, and EL MUST simply ignore safeBlockHash. If we won't have `get_safe_head` on CL side at the Merge I'd suggest to explicitly specify `headBlockHash` value to be passed as `safeBlockHash` parameter in CL spec. Teku is just sending head block hash at the moment. I’ve seen the start of an algorithm for deciding the safe head but it was still needing some work (and I have been slack and haven’t reviewed it well yet). Same with prysm. We implemented some of the safe head algo, but there are still a few questions to be answered in the working group could you pls link the PR 🙂 <dannyryan> Agree that head is the most same stub for safe head considering use cases

excerpts.author: m.kalinin
excerpts.content:
Which value is currently sent as `safeBlockHash` in `fcU` by different CL clients? Asking this because I can't find any recommendations other than the one we have in the Kintsugi spec:

> Thus, CL client software MUST use headBlockHash value as a stub for the safeBlockHash parameter, and EL MUST simply ignore safeBlockHash.

If we won't have `get_safe_head` on CL side at the Merge I'd suggest to explicitly specify `headBlockHash` value to be passed as `safeBlockHash` parameter in CL spec.
